name: World Cup Predictor
author: ianhaycox

sections.description:
World Cup Predictor is a free WordPress plugin that allows you to create prediction games for football tournaments like the FIFA World Cup.

Engage your audience, increase interaction and let users compete by predicting match results, group standings and knockout stages.

🎯 Perfect for:
– Football websites and blogs
– Tipsters and betting communities
– Fan engagement campaigns
– World Cup events and promotions

🔥 Live Demo:
https://wcp.net.br/predictions

Features

✔ Match predictions system
✔ Automatic group tables
✔ Knockout stage simulation
✔ User rankings and scoring
✔ Easy integration with any WordPress theme
✔ Works with World Cup 2026 (48 teams format)

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Import teams, venues and matches
  3. Create prediction pages automatically
  4. Let users submit their predictions
  5. Track rankings and results

Support

If you enjoy the plugin or want to support its development:
https://wcp.net.br/why-your-support-matters
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/world-cup-predictor
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WCP Cup → Overview
  4. Import teams and matches
  5. Create your prediction pages
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes, World Cup Predictor is completely free.

Does it support World Cup 2026?

Yes, the plugin supports the new 48 teams format.

Can I customize scoring rules?

Yes, you can define how users earn points based on predictions.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to adapt to most WordPress themes.
